scientific_integrity: Full universal proof supplied; exact finite tests are corroboration only; no claim of independent validation or absolute novelty.
scientific_limitations: Exact nonnegative divisible actions; each vertex has at most one outgoing influence neighbor; thresholds positive and spillovers unit weight. No extension asserted to denser directed networks, welfare, or dynamic stability. Historical-priority risk remains for general complementarity theory and inaccessible Fu et al. (2022).
title: Generic equilibrium uniqueness and exact degeneracy on one-out-neighbor public-goods networks
